header.title: The Korean War
header.subtitle: 25 Jun 1950 - 27 Jul 1953
header.hook: The front swept the length of Korea twice. Then it froze for two years.
header.footnote: Front lines simplified from US Army official histories.
header.outro: The line where the fighting stopped still divides Korea today.

events.title: The invasion
events.text: North Korean forces cross the 38th parallel before dawn.

events.title: Seoul falls
events.text: Day 4. South Korea's capital is lost.

events.title: Battle of Osan
events.text: The first American troops to fight are overrun.

events.title: Taejon falls
events.text: The US 24th Division is driven out.

events.title: The Pusan Perimeter
events.text: UN forces hold the last corner of Korea behind the Naktong River.

events.title: Inchon
events.text: An amphibious landing far behind North Korean lines.

events.title: Seoul retaken
events.text: Forces from Inchon and Pusan link up. North Korea's army collapses.

events.title: Across the 38th
events.text: South Korean troops push into the North.

events.title: Pyongyang taken
events.text: That night, Chinese troops begin crossing the Yalu.

events.title: China enters the war
events.text: Its first offensive strikes as a patrol reaches the Yalu.

events.title: Home by Christmas
events.text: The UN offensive meant to end the war begins.

events.title: Chosin Reservoir
events.text: Chinese forces surround US Marines in sub-zero cold.

events.title: Pyongyang abandoned
events.text: The UN retreat from the North.

events.title: Hungnam evacuated
events.text: About 100,000 troops and 98,000 civilians leave by sea.

events.title: Seoul falls again
events.text: The capital changes hands for the third time.

events.title: Chipyong-ni
events.text: A surrounded US regiment holds. China's advance stalls.

events.title: Seoul retaken again
events.text: Fourth change of hands. The city lies in ruins.

events.title: MacArthur relieved
events.text: Truman removes the UN commander.

events.title: Spring Offensive
events.text: China's largest attack of the war.

events.title: Talks begin
events.text: Negotiations open at Kaesong. Two more years of fighting follow.

events.title: Heartbreak Ridge
events.text: Weeks of fighting for a few hills. This is the war now.

events.title: The last offensive
events.text: China pushes the line back one final time at Kumsong.

events.title: Armistice
events.text: Signed at Panmunjom. No peace treaty has ever followed.

youtube.title: The Korean War, Day by Day (1950-1953)
youtube.summary: Every day of the Korean War on one map: the invasion, the Pusan Perimeter, Inchon, China's entry, the retreat from the North, and two years of stalemate that drew the line still dividing Korea.
